author: IdahoOutdoorsman
notes_extra: Tikka T-3. Berger VLD Hunting 115 gr. Groups about 1.5 in at 100 yards in this post. On Jun 30 he said 0.050 off produced half-inch groups and the rifle does not like COAL over 2.684. He named CCI 200 primers then.

author: earlcurtis67
notes_extra: Shoots well with both 115 Bergers and 117 Interlocks, so the charge is shared. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is 25-06.

author: STOMP442

author: KMart
